newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tamsa sharply down after earnings report.
newsitem.headline: Tamsa sharply down after earnings report.

text.p: Shares of Mexico's Tubos de Acero de Mexico SA (Tamsa) were sharply down by midafternoon Monday amid disappointment over earnings posted by the steel tube maker, analysts said.
Tamsa's nominative shares were down 8.70 pesos to 142.30 pesos on the Mexican bourse.

"On the positive side, Tamsa posted record quarterly production volume and paid off $45 million in debt, which led to savings on interest payments," said Victoria Santaella, an equity analyst at Santander Investment.

"Nonetheless, this did not offset a fall in the high-value-added products sold to Pemex," she said, referring to sales to the state oil corporation. "That was not expected, and that is what the market is recognizing," she added.
On Friday evening, Tamsa said first-half earnings fell to 661.11 million pesos from 1.057 billion pesos for the same period last year.
